da-non-sequitur.evidence: S↔P: the prf is circular. It asserts the conclusion as its reason: "These are equal because the Markov trace product formula is an **exact algebraic identity** … evaluate the same element of H_N(q)" (prf:17-20). It never defines V̂_i^const, nor proves that grouping crossings "by generator index" (prf:8-10) preserves the trace. The cited thm:markov-trace-product carries the whole claim. Under the natural reading of "group by generator index and trace each group", the identity fails. Exact sympy in H_3 under convention D: tr_M(σ₁σ₂σ₁σ₂) = q²(q⁶+q²−1)/(q²+1)², while (tr_M(σ₁²))² = (q⁴+1)²/(q²+1)². The difference is −(q⁴+q²+1)/(q²+1)² ≠ 0. The statement's further "= P_{K_𝔥}(q)" (md:13), identifying the raw trace with a knot polynomial, is unproved. markov-pair-z2.ts:39 notes a raw Markov-trace value is not a link invariant.
